So what exactly is this meant to accomplish? Is reCaptcha compiling addresses for some reason?
What is the reCaptcha trying to accomplish?

I feel like one of these days Google is going to use all of the information its collected to make one big MMORPG game that can be accessed by some 4D device (like Occulus Rift) and enslave the human race... and we won't even notice it, because we'll all be thinking we're in the real world when we're actually in the Googleverse.
